instructions: Apply guidance based on file path. For content files under contents/: Ensure everything in PostHog style guides located in the contents/handbook/wizard-and-docs/docs-style-guide.mdx and contents/handbook/content/posthog-style-guide.md files are enforced. These rules are especially important: words are spelled using American English, titles are in sentence case, feature names (e.g. feature flags or product analytics) are in sentence case too, use relative URLs for internal links, and http://app.posthog.com instead of http://us.posthog.com or http://eu.posthog.com for links to the app. For website code under src/: do not apply the writing style guides; instead review for (1) correctness: bugs, broken logic, and unhandled edge cases; (2) duplication: check whether an existing component, hook, or utility elsewhere in the repo already solves the problem, and flag logic copied from elsewhere that should be consolidated into a shared solution in this PR; (3) abstraction and API design: whether the component is the right shape, whether prop and parameter names are intuitive, and whether state is owned at the right level; (4) root cause: flag duct-tape fixes that patch a symptom (special-case conditionals, hard-coded values, copy-pasted overrides) instead of the underlying issue, and describe the underlying fix; (5) repo conventions from CLAUDE.md and the agents/ guides: use pnpm never npm, use Tailwind @container queries instead of media queries because all pages render in resizable windows, never use stock Tailwind colors (only project color tokens), import Radix primitives via the wrappers in src/components/RadixUI rather than directly from the radix-ui package, custom OS-style components use the OS prefix (OSButton, OSTable), check src/hooks/useProduct.ts and src/hooks/useProducts.tsx before hard-coding product data, and if a page moved or was renamed verify a redirect was added in vercel.json. Do not comment on prose style in code files. Thank you for your service.

gatsby/**
plugins/**
scripts/**

/*.ts
/*.jsx

contents/**/*.js
